description: Connect Cohearo to search and work with your synced meeting and interview transcripts. Find recordings by keyword, date, speaker, folder, or label; read transcript content; and ask ChatGPT to summarize discussions, compare interviews, or extract decisions and action items. Browse recordings you own and those in folders shared with you. You can also rename recordings, replace their labels, and update speaker names across your transcripts. Requires a Cohearo account and transcripts available through Cohearo's cloud service.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my latest recording and highlight decisions and action items.
Find recordings where we discussed a project budget.
Show my folders and help me find a recording.
